item.title: Apple Revives iPhone 5s With Surprise Update, Extends Key Services Until 2027
item.description: Apple unexpectedly updates the 12-year-old iPhone 5s, keeping iMessage, FaceTime, and essential services running smoothly until 2027.

item.title: Rhythm and grace mark Udbhava national dance festival
item.description: Udbhava National Dance Festival, curated and organized by senior ‘Kuchipudi’ Guru Sudheer Rao under the banner of his dance institution Sadguru Shri Shivananda Nrithyamala, was held at Ravindra Bharathi for two consecutive days. item.title: Governor leads solemn wreath laying ceremony on 77th Republic Day
item.description: Hyderabad /Secunderabad: The 77th Republic Day was marked with solemnity at the Veerula Sainik Smarak in Secunderabad, where the Governor of Telangana Jishnu Dev Varma paid floral tributes to the brave soldiers who laid down their lives for India’s sovereignty and security.The Governor was accompanied by Deputy Chief Minister Mallu Bhatti Vikramarka, Minister for IT, Commerce and Legislative Affairs D Sridhar Babu, and General Officer Commanding for the Telangana and Andhra Sub Area Ajay Misra.

item.title: Telangana universities celebrate 77th Republic Day with visionary goals
item.description: Hyderabad: The 77th Republic Day was celebrated with grandeur across the premier universities of Telangana on Monday.
